styles.use_zh: 日光人像、浅色衣物；先校准白平衡
styles.use_en: Daylight portraits and pale fabrics; balance white first

styles.use_zh: 明亮日常、建筑；不补救过曝
styles.use_en: Bright everyday scenes and architecture; cannot recover clipping

styles.use_zh: 园林、山野、石材；避免把肤色当植物
styles.use_en: Gardens, hills and stone; inspect skin near foliage

styles.use_zh: 阳光街景、彩色招牌；高感噪点不会消失
styles.use_en: Sunlit streets and colored signs; does not remove noise

styles.use_zh: 窗边、室内暖光；中性色会有意偏色
styles.use_en: Window light and warm interiors; intentionally tinted neutrals

styles.use_zh: 海天、浅蓝织物；蓝色本身需有细节
styles.use_en: Sea, sky and pale blue fabrics; requires existing blue detail

styles.use_zh: 砖墙、秋色、静物；不制造胶片颗粒
styles.use_en: Brick, autumn and still life; adds no film grain

styles.use_zh: 蓝调时刻、混合灯光；不替代降噪或局部蒙版
styles.use_en: Blue hour and mixed light; no denoising or local masks

styles.use_zh: 光影、人像、建筑；灰阶映射不是黑白乳剂
styles.use_en: Light, portraits and architecture; tonal mapping, not a BW emulsion

styles.use_zh: 静物、雨天、纪实；有意保留微量暖冷双色
styles.use_en: Still life, rain and documentary; subtle warm/cool duotone
